name: Transcribe new podcast episodes from an RSS feed

parameters.content:
## Podcast RSS transcription — supervised starter

Poll a feed, validate and deduplicate this poll, and submit ONE bounded batch to Audio Transcriber. All dataset rows, including errors, reach the output.

Setup: install the Apify community node, set feed URL and polling interval, attach your Apify credential, choose a per-batch budget, and replace the output with a destination that saves transcripts AND errors.

Keep inactive until tested in your n8n installation. This is NOT a durable new-episode ledger: edited dates, replays and uncertain retries can charge again. Do not enable automatic retries. Before retrying, inspect the original Apify run/dataset.

Managed audio costs $0.01 per rounded audio-minute plus $0.00005 per run at 512 MB. The $1 budget covers this whole poll, not each episode; at most 99 whole minutes fit after the start fee. It does not cap monthly spending.

Guide: https://github.com/jx-yan/n8n-transcription-workflows/blob/master/podcast-transcription-guide.md

### 1 — Validate before spending
The RSS trigger uses publication dates, not a delivery ledger. Exact GUID/URL repeats in this poll are collapsed. Missing or non-HTTP(S) enclosures fail the execution before the paid node. No HTML page-link fallback.

### 2 — One run per poll
Submit all validated enclosure URLs in ONE Actor call. Retries are off. A timeout can still mean the Actor ran: inspect Apify before replaying. The cap is for the whole batch.

### 3 — Save successes AND failures
Replace the output stub with persistent storage that keeps every row. Set up an n8n error workflow too. A successful run may contain error/skip rows. No delivery destination is configured in this starter.

nodes.name: New episode published
nodes.notes: Set feedUrl and poll interval. Date-based polling can skip late/backdated episodes and repeat edited/manual items. Restart persistence is not a paid-delivery ledger.

nodes.name: Extract audio URL
nodes.notes: Batch-local GUID and exact URL deduplication only. Signed URL changes can evade URL dedup when no stable GUID exists. Invalid enclosure stops the poll before spending; saved execution input is the recovery source.

nodes.name: Transcribe episode
nodes.notes: Attach Apify credentials. One $1-capped run for all unique enclosures in this poll at 512 MB. Never automatically retry an ambiguous timeout; inspect the original run first.

nodes.name: Keep all results
nodes.notes: Keep every dataset row. Downstream must handle transcript and error types; unknown shapes remain visible. Empty output fails loudly.

nodes.name: Results and errors
nodes.notes: REPLACE with a durable destination that stores all rows. Add an n8n error workflow for node/API failures. Save run IDs from Apify Console during pilot recovery. Never replay the entire poll just because destination delivery failed.
